$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: The transfer fee is {transferFee}, and the rate changes after {promoMonths} months
templates.body: Transferring {transferAmount} has a fee of {transferFee} ({transferFeePct}). The rate is {promoRatePct} for {promoMonths} months, then {revertRatePct} a year. If you pay only the minimum, {remainingAfterPromo} is still owed when the introductory period ends, and the following year adds {chargeYearAfterPromo} in interest.

templates.headline: Before you transfer a balance
templates.body: A balance transfer usually has a fee, and its introductory rate lasts for a set period. After that, the card's standard rate applies to whatever is still owed. You can see the terms in the app, or ask us, before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل تحويل الرصيد
templates.body: تحويل الرصيد تترتب عليه عادةً رسوم، ويسري معدله التمهيدي لفترة محددة. بعدها يُطبَّق المعدل المعتاد للبطاقة على ما يبقى مستحقاً. يمكنك الاطلاع على الشروط في التطبيق أو سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.
